package.description: A challenging 2D motocross platform game, where physics play an important role.

en-US.description: A challenging 2D motocross platform game, where physics play an important role.
en-US.longDescription:
X-Moto is a challenging 2D motocross platform game, where physics play an all important role in the gameplay.
You need to control your bike to its limit, if you want to have a chance finishing the more difficult of the challenges.
en-US.name: xmoto
